name: Yang Decomposition Level
definition: For a nonempty dismantlable ample class $C$, $\kappa(C)$ is the least $k\ge0$ such that the Yang complex of $C$ is pure $k$-decomposable, equivalently $C\in\mathcal D_k$ under the recursive face-attachment definition.
normalization: $\mathcal D_0$ is the recursively peripheral class; every dismantlable ample class has finite decomposition level.
comments: The invariant measures decomposition complexity of the class itself. The separate parent-depth hierarchy minimizes a decomposition bound over maximum parents.
